name: premiere-pro-full-mcp
description: Local-first Adobe Premiere Pro MCP: 353 flat tools over one persistent CEP WebSocket bridge. No auth, no approval, no actionId.

interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to the local Premiere Pro Full MCP bridge over one persistent WebSocket. Every operation is its own flat tool (set_active_sequence, add_to_timeline, split_clip, ...). No auth, no approval dialogs, no hidden actionId.
defaultPrompt: List the sequences in my open Premiere project
Activate sequence X, add this clip to the timeline, and split it at 5s
Inspect the active sequence tracks and summarize the edit
